title: Secrets Drop Box, Wake-on-Connect Gatekeeper & Agent Tool Intent
summary: Deployed a new Secrets Drop Box service for out-of-band credential ingestion over Cloudflare Access, backed by native Kubernetes Secrets with a CLI sanitize tool that redacts known secret values from text. Rolled out a label-driven transient gatekeeper that scales 23 services to zero on idle and auto-wakes them on first request, with multi-host/per-port routing and network policies. Added a synthetic _intent parameter to every agent tool call, intercepted and stripped before MCP forwarding, and rendered alongside tool calls in Discord.

title: 3D Print Tooling: Interactive G-code Previewer & 3MF Library, Hermes Go Rewrite Milestone
summary: Shipped an interactive 3D G-code previewer that animates toolpaths layer-by-layer during playback with tool-change indicators, orbit controls, build-plate rendering, and merged solid layer meshes for mobile-friendly performance. Launched a color-rendered 3MF file library, and fixed a browser GPU crash by serializing WebGL thumbnail rendering with immediate context disposal; also revived a stalled CI runner and worked around a shared pipeline docker-socket mount bug to unblock builds. Landed the first working milestone of a Go rewrite of the Hermes agent core (chat loop + Discord adapter) with all checks green.

title: Attachment Resolver Preview Page, Gateway Memory Hardening & Hermes Go Rewrite Scope
summary: Added an HTML preview page with download button to the Discord attachment resolver (Go service, shipped via Gitea CI). Resolved a 502 outage on the attachment resolver by reducing Hermes gateway memory limits and restored session resumption after a DNS failure. Scoped a Go rewrite of the Hermes core loop and Discord adapter into a 35-week milestone plan using ephemeral Python tool workers.

title: Rayobrowse Session Store — Keyed Persistent Browser Sessions
summary: Implemented a Go-based keyed, persistent browser-session store for the rayobrowse CDP browser, deployed to k3s with Longhorn-backed PVC storage. Proved end-to-end session restoration — an authenticated login was reopened from a fresh browser using restored cookies and localStorage. Discovered and documented three real bugs (localStorage capture format mismatch, wrong cookie CDP commands, browser reaping mid-session) and stored platform credentials in the KDBX vault.

title: Discord Attachment Resolver Deploy & Hermes Source Migration to Gitea
summary: Shipped the attachment resolver service — a Go-based Discord attachment URL resolver with HMAC-signed links, deployed via Gitea Actions CI to k3s with release artifacts and a smoke-tested binary. Migrated the Hermes Agent source tree from GitHub to a self-hosted Gitea instance with host-scoped credential helper and a fork-sync update path. Completed an independent security audit of the SWA dashboard Functions API confirming current responses are clean, while disclosing a historical pre-redaction deployment window and an unauthorized production commit that fixed a category-slug XSS sink.

title: STL Web Previewer Deploy & Hermes Profiles k3s Migration
summary: Built and deployed an interactive STL web previewer service (Flask + Three.js) through the full Gitea-to-CI-to-k3s pipeline, accepting STL uploads and serving viewable links. Migrated the hermes-profiles management app from a host systemd service to a k3s pod with Traefik ingress, hostPath volumes, and network policy. Also resolved Gitea Actions CI failures including missing registry push token scopes and fixed camera-service IngressRoute path routing conflicts.

title: Headless Multi-Color Slicer
summary: Started a headless CLI pipeline for multi-color (AMS) slicing on the Bambu P1S — extracting Bambu Studio's extruder-mapping machinery and driving OrcaSlicer headless from generated OpenSCAD STLs. Open problem: CLI mode forces single-extruder output from the P1S profile.

title: Discord Forum Tooling Migration & Gateway Patch
summary: Implemented declarative per-forum tooling context via Gitea-hosted YAML with 20 forum overrides, extended ChannelOverride with toolsets/skills/context/docs fields, and patched the gateway for toolset resolution and context injection with a 15-minute mirror cron. Also added a 48-hour purge cron for the Discord attachments channel and improved sidecar filenames to use readable tool-kind labels.

title: Azure SWA Dashboard Deploy
summary: Rewrote the personal blog as a homelab dashboard on Azure Static Web Apps with API proxy functions and real-time cluster monitoring.

title: Multi-Agent Content Pipeline
summary: Built a pipeline where RSS feeds are discovered, claim-ordered by AI agents, written in parallel, and auto-published after QA review.

title: k3s Worker Node Onboarding
summary: Onboarded a new Dell Wyse 5070 thin client as a k3s worker node with VAAPI hardware transcoding support.

title: Hermes A2A Peer Channels
summary: Implemented bot-to-bot Telegram DM channels between Hermes profiles for inter-agent communication and task delegation.

title: Cloudflare WAN Failover
summary: Configured OPNsense multi-WAN with automatic cellular (T-Mobile) backup gateway failover via Cloudflare tunnels.

title: Bambu Lab P1S Integration
summary: Built headless slicing and print management for the Bambu Lab P1S 3D printer, accessible via API and Telegram bot commands.

title: WiFi Positioning System
summary: Designed an indoor WiFi positioning system for the homelab using UniFi AP signal strength data and fingerprinting.

title: KeePass Credential Vault
summary: Deployed a KeePass vault for homelab credentials with automated rotation, secure sharing across agents, and backup to encrypted storage.

title: Nightly Red Team Audit
summary: Implemented automated adversarial security reviews running nightly against all homelab services with alerting and remediation suggestions.

title: Jellyfin Media Pipeline
summary: Built automated media library management with transcoding workers, metadata scraping, and Telegram-notify on new content arrival.
